Episode: Mega Evolution |nextlink=Wonder Voyage |next=Pocket Monsters: Wonder Voyage |seo= }} (Japanese: '''ライジングアゲイン''' ''Rising Again'') is the seventh arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that began airing on October 31, 2025 in Japan. It follows [[Episode: Mega Evolution]] in broadcast order and the ''[[Mega Voltage]]'' arc chronologically. This arc features the [[Liko]] and her friends preparing for their final showdown with the [[Explorers]] and seeking out a way rid the world of [[Laquium]]. It was first announced on September 19, 2025. The arc's opening theme is [[Iolite]] performed by {{wp|Eve (Japanese singer)|Eve}}, and the ending theme is [[Asleep or Awake]] by [[Polkadot Stingray]]. ==Plot== {{incomplete|section|Summary of the Rising Volt Tacklers' activities after they visit Blueberry Academy}} The arc takes place as the main characters seek to become stronger through intensive training at the academy, with [[Friede]]'s current whereabouts remaining unknown. At the academy, they encounter various characters including academy founder and director [[Cyrano]], as well as familiar faces from their previous adventures such as [[Ann]] and [[Briar]]. The arc also introduces new characters, including [[Drayton]] and [[Lacey]] (who is accompanied by her {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}}), members of the [[BB League|Blueberry Elite Four]]. ==Gallery==
